scope: Small source audit for the manufactured writer/reader calibration. It does not assert the physical world orientation of any production case.

evidence.fact: JPartDataBi4 writes Idp as DatUint or Ipd as DatUllong, Posd as DatDouble3 or Pos as DatFloat3, Vel as DatFloat3, and Rhop as DatFloat.
tfloat3 and tdouble3 are plain structs with fields x,y,z in that storage order.
The official type names and element sizes are uint=4, float=4, double=8, float3=12, and double3=24 bytes on the compiled host.
The read-only adapter loads the BI4 with JBinaryData, writes metadata XML, and emits one binary file per decoded array; it does not assign physical roles or axes.
